Looking at the plate, I see scrambled or fried eggs, roughly 2 eggs' worth, and about 5 slices of sausage, which looks like chorizo.

Eggs: about 100 g at roughly 150 kcal per 100 g, so about 150 kcal. Some oil may have been used in cooking, so I'll round to 170 kcal.

Chorizo slices: about 5 slices, around 40 g total. Chorizo runs about 450 kcal per 100 g, so about 180 kcal.

Total: about 350 kcal over about 140 g of food.
